project.objective: Identify the parents of James Tarrant (b. 1792 South Carolina, d. Gallatin County, Illinois; FamilySearch GHLT-TFG), resolving the two competing parent sets in the FamilySearch tree: Samuel Tarrant & Elizabeth (MYBY-58M/GQJT-5K2) vs. James Tarrant Sr. & Jane Burch (LJKZ-ZX1/LC1Y-DZJ).
project.title: James Tarrant's parents

researcher_profile.narration_guidance: One-line preamble per skill invocation explaining what you're about to do. Assume basic GPS vocabulary. Define unusual or specialized terminology inline.

questions.question: Who was the father of James Tarrant (b. 1792 Greenville County, South Carolina; resided Gallatin County, Illinois 1840–1870; husband of Jane Bruce)?
questions.rationale: The FamilySearch tree attaches James to two competing, unsourced parent sets — Samuel Tarrant (Warren Co., KY) and James Tarrant Sr. (d. Jefferson Co., AL). Every downstream ancestral line depends on choosing correctly. Census, military, probate, and tax records for Warren Co., KY and Greenville Co., SC are available to test both candidates.

items.rationale: The 1810 index names only 'Saml Tarrant' (log_001, XH29-646). The original page (image group 004185989_009) gives age-bracket tallies; a male 16–25 fits James (b. 1792). Also tests the tree's 1802 death date for Samuel.

items.jurisdiction: United States (War of 1812 pension index; bounty-land warrants)
items.rationale: Search 'United States, War of 1812 Index to Pension Application Files' (coll. 1834325) for James or widow Jane Tarrant. Pension/bounty files often give birthplace, marriage date/place and residences, which can place James in Samuel's household or county.
Deeds for Samuel Tarrant selling Greenville land would date his move to Kentucky and confirm he was in Greenville when James was born there in 1792.

query.target: Saml Tarrant household, 1810 census, Warren Co., KY

log.notes: Original 1810 page located (image 00264, p. 267). Saml Tarrant: 1 male 45+, 2 males 16-25, 2 females 45+, no children, no slaves. A male 16-25 fits James (b. 1792); Samuel alive in 1810 contradicts tree death 1802.

query.collection: United States, War of 1812 Index to Pension Application Files, 1812-1910

log.notes: 4 Tarrant entries. Two cards are one file: James Tarrent/Taurent, Capt. Joseph Price's Co., Tennessee Militia; survivor's application S.O. 21083, certificate S.C. 15209 (survivor pensions were granted under the 1871 act, so this soldier was alive c. 1871+); bounty land in separate file. No widow named. Benjamin and Richard Tarrant not relevant.

query.keywords: +(Samuel OR Saml) +(Tarrant OR Tarrent OR Tarrants)

log.notes: Key: 5 May 1792 deed, Samuel Tarrant of Greenville Co. sells 172 acres on Reedy River to Larkin Tarrant (acknowledged May term 1792) - Samuel divesting in the year of James's birth, consistent with a move to Kentucky. A Samuel Tarrant also appears in Greenville in 1815, 1827 and 1829 - a second (younger) Samuel stayed in SC.
